nodes.text: The number of cases of pneumonia in mainland China has worsened and there is no cure. People are shocked: it has exceeded the number in 2020. The #ChinaCDC recently warned that the number of cases of #humaninterstitialpneumonia(HMPV)infection has increased significantly since the winter.
